issues.description: In the solution, the createPerson handler method in PersonResource is declared with protected visibility, whereas the analogous methods in NoteResource are public and the problem statement suggests students should use NoteResource as an example. This inconsistency in visibility between the two REST controllers may confuse students (they may copy the public method style from NoteResource) and could lead to uncertainty about the expected method visibility for Spring controller handler methods.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the visibility consistent between the two resources. Change the PersonResource.createPerson method to public (i.e., public ResponseEntity<Person> createPerson(...)) so it matches NoteResource and the example students are directed to. Alternatively, make all controller handler methods consistently public across resources and update any documentation/comments to reflect that.
